# Processing full-text .xml in to section .txt files

## Extracting methods sections

```{bash extract_methods_sections, eval = T, results = 'hide'}

source spacyr_venv/bin/activate

# use bash script to extract methods sections from all full text xmls, and save to output/fulltexts/methods
# don't apply to archived directory
for dir in output/fulltexts/*/; do
  [[ "$dir" == "output/fulltexts/archived/" ]] && continue
  
  echo "Processing directory: $dir"
  code/extract_text/batch_process_methods.sh \
    "$dir" \
    output/methods
done

```

```{bash rename_methods_files, results = 'hide'}

shopt -s nullglob

europe_pmc_conv=output/fulltexts/pmid_to_pmcid_mapping.csv

awk -F',' 'NR > 1 && $2 ~ /^PMC/ {
    gsub(/"/, "", $1)
    gsub(/"/, "", $2)
    if ($1 != "") print $2, $1
}' "$europe_pmc_conv" > /tmp/pmc_to_pmid.txt

head /tmp/pmc_to_pmid.txt

for f in output/methods/PMC*_methods*.txt; do
    filename=$(basename "$f")

    pmcid="${filename%_methods.txt}"
    pmcid="${pmcid%_methods_main.txt}"
    pmid=$(awk -v p="$pmcid" '$1 == p {print $2}' /tmp/pmc_to_pmid.txt)

    if [[ -n "$pmid" ]]; then
        # Preserve which suffix the original file had
        if [[ "$filename" == *_methods_main.txt ]]; then
            new_file="output/methods/${pmid}_methods_main.txt"
        else
            new_file="output/methods/${pmid}_methods.txt"
        fi
        
        # don't rename the file if a file with the same name already exists
        if [[ -e "$new_file" ]]; then
            echo "SKIPPING — destination exists: $new_file"
        else
            mv -v "$f" "$new_file"
        fi
            
    else
        echo "No PMID mapping: $f"
    fi
done

```

### Total number of extracted methods sections 

```{r total_number_extracted_methods, eval = T}

gwas_study_info <- data.table::fread(here::here("output/icd_map/gwas_study_gbd_causes.csv"))

gwas_study_info = gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x))

gwas_study_info = gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::filter(cause != "") |>
  dplyr::filter(include == T)

all_pmids = gwas_study_info |> 
        dplyr::pull(PUBMED_ID) |>
        unique()

methods_files <-
  list.files(here::here("output/methods/"),
             pattern = "\\.txt$")

methods_files <- basename(methods_files) |> 
  stringr::str_remove_all("_methods.txt|_methods_main.txt") |>
  stringr::str_remove_all("_bioc|_pdf_tei") |> 
  unique()

methods_files <- methods_files[!methods_files %in% c("failed_files.txt",
                                                     "no_methods_files.txt",
                                                     "main_fallback_files.txt")]

methods_pmids <- unique(methods_files)
methods_pmids <- methods_pmids[methods_pmids %in% all_pmids]

print("Number of PMIDs with methods sections extracted:")
sum(all_pmids %in% methods_pmids)

print("% of total PMIDs with methods sections extracted:")
100 * sum(all_pmids %in% methods_pmids) / length(all_pmids)

```

results_files <-

## Extracting introduction sections

```{bash extract_intro_sections, results = 'hide'}

source spacyr_venv/bin/activate

# use bash script to extract methods sections from all full text xmls, and save to output/fulltexts/intros
# don't apply to archived directory
for dir in output/fulltexts/*/; do
  [[ "$dir" == "output/fulltexts/archived/" ]] && continue
  
  echo "Processing directory: $dir"
  code/extract_text/batch_process_intro.sh \
    "$dir" \
    output/intros
done

```

```{bash rename_intro_files, eval = T, results = 'hide'}

shopt -s nullglob

for f in output/intros/PMC*_intro*.txt; do
    filename=$(basename "$f")

    pmcid="${filename%_intro.txt}"
    pmcid="${pmcid%_intro_main.txt}"
    pmcid="${pmcid%_intro_lead.txt}"
    pmid=$(awk -v p="$pmcid" '$1 == p {print $2}' /tmp/pmc_to_pmid.txt)

    if [[ -n "$pmid" ]]; then
        # Preserve which suffix the original file had
        if [[ "$filename" == *_intro_main.txt ]]; then
            new_file="output/intros/${pmid}_intro_main.txt"
        elif [[ "$filename" == *_intro_lead.txt ]]; then
            new_file="output/intros/${pmid}_intro_lead.txt"
        else
            new_file="output/intros/${pmid}_intro.txt"
        fi

        # don't rename the file if a file with the same name already exists
        if [[ -e "$new_file" ]]; then
            echo "SKIPPING — destination exists: $new_file"
        else
            mv -v "$f" "$new_file"
        
        fi
            
    else
        echo "No PMID mapping: $f"
    fi
done

```

### Total number of extracted intro sections 

```{r total_number_of_extracted_intros, eval = T}

intro_files <-
  list.files(here::here("output/intros/"),
             pattern = "\\.txt$")

intro_files <- basename(intro_files) |> 
  stringr::str_remove_all("_intro.txt|_intro_main.txt|_intro_lead.txt") |> 
  stringr::str_remove_all("_bioc|_pdf_tei") |> 
  unique()

intro_files <- intro_files[!intro_files%in% c("failed_files.txt",
                                               "no_intro_files.txt",
                                               "main_fallback_files.txt")]

intro_pmids <- unique(intro_files)
intro_pmids <- intro_pmids[intro_pmids %in% all_pmids]

print("Number of PMIDs with introduction sections extracted:")
sum(all_pmids %in% intro_pmids)

print("% of total PMIDs with introduction sections extracted")
100 * sum(all_pmids %in% intro_pmids) / length(all_pmids)

```





# Convert article sections to sentences

```{bash convert_abstracts_to_sentences, eval = T, results = 'hide'}

mkdir -p output/abstracts/abstracts_sentences
source spacyr_venv/bin/activate

python3 code/extract_text/spacy_obtain_sentences.py \
--input_dir output/abstracts \
--output_dir output/abstracts/abstracts_sentences

```
